description: Two-tile heterogeneous Chipyard SoC with one Shuttle+Gemmini-RoCC tile and one Shuttle+Saturn-OPU vector tile. Matches chipyard.HeteroConfigs.GemminiAndOPUShuttleConfig (tile 0 = Shuttle + Gemmini RoCC; tile 1 = Shuttle + Saturn OPU vector unit, vLen=128). XPU-RT pins each dispatch to a specific tile via the schedule's hardware_target string; the runtime maps each (kind, hart) pair to its own worker queue.

cores.name: gemmini0
cores.description: Shuttle scalar + Gemmini int8 RoCC (DIM=16, f32 acc_scale). Int8 matmul + conv-as-im2col-tiled-matmul; everything else falls back to scalar on the same hart.

cores.name: opu0
cores.description: Shuttle + Saturn OPU vector unit. RVV plus the four Saturn custom OP-V instructions (VOPACC, OPMVINBCAST, VMV_RV, VMV_VR). Int8 outer-product matmul + conv-as-indirect-GEMM are first-class; standard RVV ops also run here.

notes: FireSim bitstream for this exact 2-tile topology is not yet built; spike via the merlin/tools/spike-hetero wrapper is the functional simulator today. spike-hetero loads both Gemmini and Saturn OPU extensions into one binary so a 2-hart ELF can decode RoCC custom-3 and OP-V instructions side-by-side.

spike-hetero is functional-only — both extensions execute atomically with no microarchitectural pipeline model. Cycle counts from spike on this target are NOT authoritative; use FireSim once the matching bitstream lands.
